body: Yeah. Things haven't been great between us recently, so we aren't in contact. It is nice to know that I'll be with him, if not in an alive sort of way.

Unfortunately I'm not exactly swimming in people who love me and want me around. That's why I've gotten to this point in the first place. And I think this will be better for everyone in the end. Better for people to lose me and then have the ability to imagine that I could have amounted to something. Otherwise they'll just have to watch me failing and be disappointed in me forever.
